title: Tori Tori no Mi, Model: Phoenix
structure: 3 abilities + Phoenix Brand as the peak (Mythical Zoan; no awakening shown)
facts: Appearance (official, One Piece Magazine Vol. 20): pineapple-shaped, skin split into fruitlets with swirls and prickly tips, crown of leaves
Mythical Zoan, Bird-Bird Fruit, Model: Phoenix: full phoenix and hybrid forms made of blue flames
Can heal others with the flames (Wano)
Seastone handcuffs blocked it at Marineford
User: Marco, first division commander of the Whitebeard Pirates

plan.fruit: **Official design** (One Piece Magazine Vol. 20, via search): a **pineapple** – oval, skin split into fruitlets that each carry a swirl and a prickly tip, with a crown of leaves (one source says golden). Drawn in blue-green with golden leaves.
cast: **Enemy (new, original):** a viking with a horned helmet and a red beard.
**Marco:** blond pineapple-tuft hair, sleepy eyes, open purple shirt with the blue Whitebeard mark on his chest; blue phoenix flames for the hybrid form.
plan.sets: giant nest on a cliff, cyan rays, tropical beach, aurora night sky, altar with blue braziers, rock arch over the sea, field-hospital tent, island village with a big statue, sunset clouds, prison cell, Marine headquarters wall, big ship deck with a white whale figurehead, pharmacy shelves.
